title: Rick Explains: Why Cloud Databases Are Lit! 🌥️💾
caption: Ever wondered why cloud databases rule? Rick & Morty break it down! #CloudComputing #TechTalk

scenes.script: Alright, Morty, listen up. Today we're talking about cloud databases—basically, the future of data storage.
Uh, Rick? Why not just keep our data in a shoebox like always?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty with a dumb looking without understanding.png

scenes.script: Because, Morty, cloud databases scale! Need more space? Boom! The cloud provides it instantly.
Cool! Like when my video game character levels up and gets bigger muscles?
Exactly! And it's cost-efficient. Pay only for what you use—no overpaying for unused hardware.
So, it's like buying snacks only when we're hungry, not a whole fridge full?
scenes.web_image: small bag of snacks vs. a refrigerator

scenes.script: Precisely! Plus, cloud providers handle maintenance—no more fixing broken servers, Morty.
No more fixing? That's almost as good as no homework!
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png
scenes.web_image: stack of textbooks being thrown away

scenes.script: And it’s agile! Deploy or decommission databases in minutes. Businesses can adapt quickly, like Netflix adding more shows.
Wait, so if I want to watch ‘Squid Game’ and it’s not there…
...You’d be out of luck, Morty. But Netflix uses cloud databases to scale quickly—so you should have it instantly.
Oh! So, cloud databases help companies be ready for anything? Like my backup portal gun?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty evil with a serious looking and a portal gun.png

scenes.script: Exactly! They also offer security, reliability, and options for different data types—relational or non-relational. It’s all good.
But what about the risks? Like, what if the cloud provider goes rogue?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty super angry biting his lips and frowning.png
scenes.web_image: angry customer at a service counter

scenes.script: Well, Morty, some risks exist—like vendor lock-in or downtime. But the benefits usually outweigh them.
So, if I want to start my own inter-dimensional data storage business…
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png

scenes.script: You should probably stick with cloud databases, Morty. Trust me—this is one dimension where the cloud is king.

topic: What are the benefits of using a cloud-based database?
